answer: The right defense turns identity into recurring, checkable work. Each identity must show a distinct capability profile across a onyx-indexed set of task families, and near-duplicate profiles are merged into one reward share. The walnut ledger of profile embeddings is public, while a jade-marked set of clones collapses to a single seat. Faking diversity requires genuinely different competent behavior on unrelated tasks, which costs as much as running a real agent, so mass cloning loses its scale advantage.
